## Change

Describe the problem, the requirement and the change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Added a failing test before the implementation.
- [ ] Kept existing tests, or explained a requirement that proves a test wrong.
- [ ] Added a C-library fixture and golden file for a format feature.
- [ ] Cited the specification section or C source file and lines.
- [ ] Added a changelog entry.
- [ ] Passed `sh scripts/check.sh` on the development runner.
- [ ] Added no dependencies outside the approved pins or handwritten unsafe code.
- [ ] Made no support or performance claim without the required evidence.
- [ ] Retained third-party notices and followed the Code of Conduct.

Explain any item that does not apply.
